title: Rock and roll question on second tape
summary: Russell asks about rock and roll and Fats Domino's popularity.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: I was going to ask what I think of it, since you were mostly associated with Pat Stomino, not that he's a real old-time musician and all that, and one of the old pioneers of the Dixie thing, but I wondered about your reactions to the rock and roll. What made him so sensational? Did you ever figure it out? Well, the rock and roll that came from Alan Freed, he does...
